ambient_events: Sconces trace the stair rail in a thin line of gold.
The deck barely moves underfoot, the Basin held at arm's length.
Glass to port and starboard frames the water in two cold rectangles.
description: The upper-deck landing, hushed and carpeted in something deep enough to lose a coin in. The staircase descends (DOWN) to the foyer, and a slimmer stair climbs (UP) to the open sun deck. Forward (NORTH) a single sealed hatch guards the owner's suite; aft (SOUTH) the deck opens to the helipad. You can LOOK EAST or WEST out across the Basin through the smoked glass.
name: Echelon — Stair Landing
